# The Rock Factory Blackpool

> Storage units, business units, workshops, artist studios and small offices to let at The Old Rock Factory, Keswick Road (off Park Road), Blackpool FY1 5PB. Available from 1 November 2026; pre-bookings get their first week free. Enquiries and viewings by WhatsApp on 07366 991012.

- Units from £65 per week; two offices at £70 per week each (available from January 2027). Minimum term one month, subject to availability.
- Lighting, electricity and Wi-Fi connected in every unit; electricity usage charged at the supplier rate with no markup.
- 24-hour access, free app access to CCTV covering the entrance and outside the units, shared facilities.
- Business use needs prior approval. Car storage is not permitted.

- [300 sq ft two-storey unit](https://rockfactory.uk/two-storey-unit-blackpool.html): £130 a week, roller shutter, upstairs office or storage area with a window, photos
- [150 sq ft ground-floor unit](https://rockfactory.uk/150-sq-ft-unit-blackpool.html): £65 a week, roller-shutter access
- [160 sq ft ground-floor unit](https://rockfactory.uk/160-sq-ft-unit-blackpool.html): £69 a week, security-door access
